mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in declining FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0 percentage points, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0, or the average 5-day return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) both exceed 850 and 400000 respectively, it indicates robust consumer demand that supports corporate revenue growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where both HOUST > 850 and RSAFS > 400000, or the joint signal fails to outperform the market (IC < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 230), central bank policy tightening becomes likely, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 230, or the average 20-day return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 105.0, it indicates weakening manufacturing activity that reduces corporate output and profitability, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 105.0, or the average 5-day return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE >= 5.5), labor market slack reduces consumer spending power and corporate revenue growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE >= 5.5, or the average 60-day return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 850 units signals strong residential construction activity that boosts related sectors, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in high HOUST periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) both rise above their 6-month moving averages, it indicates synchronized expansion in manufacturing and construction, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where both INDPRO and HOUST exceed their 6-month moving averages, or the joint signal fails to outperform the market (IC < 0.05).
